create_multicorpus_dataset: create a MultiCorpusDataset from an OrderedDict of FairseqDataset instances with a sampling distribution
generate_ordered_indices: generate shuffled and distribution-weighted sampling indices across multiple corpora using ordered_indices
sample_from_corpora: sample individual items from multiple datasets using probabilistic distribution via the _sample method
map_index_to_dataset: map a flat index to its corresponding dataset key and internal index using _map_index
collate_multi_corpus_samples: collate samples from a multi-corpus dataset using the first dataset's collater method
